title: Customer Support Automation System - Answer, Escalate, Learn

sections.label: 1 · EVERY TICKET AND CHAT ARRIVES HERE
sections.note: One entry point for every channel. Before anything is written we know who is asking and what they asked last time.

sections.label: 2 · CLAUDE WRITES THE ANSWER FROM YOUR OWN DOCS
sections.note: It answers from your help center and past tickets, not from guesswork. It also returns how confident it is.

sections.label: 3 · ROUTE THE ANSWER AND SEND THE REPLY
sections.note: Simple questions get answered and closed. Anything about an account gets answered but stays open.

sections.label: 4 · HAND OFF TO A HUMAN, LOG EVERY TICKET
sections.note: Low confidence, refunds and complaints go to a person with the draft attached. Every ticket lands in the log either way.

sections.label: 5 · THE SYSTEM GETS MORE ACCURATE EVERY WEEK
sections.note: Once a week Claude reads what it got wrong and tells you which help docs to write next.

input_sample.subject: Order hasn't shipped and I was charged twice
input_sample.message: Hi - order #40911 still says processing after 6 days, and I see two charges of $189.00 on my card. Can someone tell me what happened?

output_sample.drafted_answer: Marisol, order #40911 is held at our fulfillment partner pending a stock check on the 24-pack. On the billing, I can see one settled charge of $189.00 and one authorization hold of $189.00 that should drop off within 3 business days - I'm sending this to a specialist to confirm and refund if it settled.
output_sample.action_taken: Escalated to a human with the full ticket history, draft attached
output_sample.reason_escalated: Confidence 0.41 and a possible duplicate charge - money moves only with a person's approval

this_week_so_far.top_gap_claude_flagged: No help doc exists for duplicate authorization holds - 19 tickets this week
